SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__ODW__ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__ODW__ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__ODW__FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__ODW__FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__ODW__FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__ODW__FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__E__ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__E__ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__E__FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__E__FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DB___County__E__FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E') AS DB___County__E__FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01') AS Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01') AS Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01') AS Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01') AS Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDTRefreshCounty' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01') AS Data_Flow_-_Load_from_County_ODW_to_County_E01_sink_TableName;
